verdict.rationale: Codegen runs agents as a hosted service. Users authenticate to it with an org_id and token through the SDK or API, and agents execute in vendor-provided isolated sandbox environments. Onboarding is just installing a GitHub/Slack app with "no complex setup required," so the user never operates backend infrastructure. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that it is a fully managed cloud offering, documentation of scaling or parallel agent runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
